title: 78 Gigawatts Of Nuclear Power Is Still Under Construction
hook: 78 gigawatts of nuclear power is still being built.
closing: The supposedly dying industry is quietly shaping tomorrow's electricity supply.
question: Would you live near nuclear power?

segments.say: Builders started 10 nuclear reactors worldwide. Construction is growing rather than disappearing.
China holds 50 percent of nuclear capacity under construction. One country drives half the buildout.
About 78 gigawatts of nuclear capacity is under construction. Tomorrow's power supply is already taking shape.
